plan.summary:
New `Record` IDs now use UUIDv7, which sort by creation time, instead of random UUIDv4.

- `Cargo.toml` swaps the `uuid` feature `v4` for `v7`.
- `Record::new` calls `Uuid::now_v7()` instead of `Uuid::new_v4()`.
- `Cargo.lock` adds the dependencies the `v7` feature needs.

Existing records keep their old IDs.
plan.riskRationale: Small change to ID generation. Only new records are affected. IDs stay valid UUIDs. Code that assumes random v4 IDs could be affected.
plan.storyArc: The PR changes how new record IDs are made. The dependency feature is enabled first. Then `Record::new` uses it. The lockfile only follows the feature change.

topics.title: Generate record IDs with UUIDv7
topics.narrativeBrief: How do new records now get their IDs, and which dependency changes allow it? Connect the `v7` feature switch, the lockfile additions (`js-sys`, `rand`), and the `Uuid::now_v7()` call. Verify the lockfile hunks belong to the `uuid` package.
